race.comment: NORMANDY PEACE (6) gets the nod after putting together the most reliable recent profile, running third in a Mdn at Warrnambool when beaten just over half a length before a sound fourth behind Prince Iadora at Hamilton. The 1800m is new ground, but he is lightly raced, race fit and brings the strongest current form. HASTA LA OINKERS (2) has placed at both runs this campaign, including a wide run when second to Fullheadofsteam at Bordertown, and looks the main danger if he holds that level third-up. MONEY WHEEL (3) improved sharply when fifth at Seymour, beaten two and a half lengths after making ground from well back at long odds, so he is a live winning hope with another step forward. PATH TO VICTORY (4) disappointed as favourite at Wycheproof but is fitter third-up and has enough substance to stay in the mix if he finishes off better.
